title: Federation link does not recover after teardown: DL560 stayed disconnected 40+ min (57 attempts) with no satellite-side reconnect
outcome:
Greg, verbatim (Asistant #2232): „system jest nonrecoverable WTF”.
Evidence:
- The DL560 satellite closed its link at 06:02:37Z (senderDeadlineExpired, inc c90b233e). After that, its console log (Asistant #2228) shows NO further federation link or reconnect lines through 06:41Z.
- Meanwhile Central's worker for DL560 reached attempt 57 in retryBackoff, with retryAfterMs ≈203 s, attestation lastReason controlEof and last success 05:55:06Z (termal_federation_status, 06:35:55Z).
- termal_list_sessions reports DL560 unavailable: 503 "peer authenticated mailbox link is unavailable".
- Earlier the same day, every teardown reconnected within seconds.
Required: after ANY link loss, whichever side tears it down and whatever the load, the pair re-establishes automatically and promptly once both hosts are up. If a stage cannot complete, it is visible with a named reason, never a silent stall. No manual restart required.
acceptance: The cause of the DL560 non-recovery after 06:02:37Z is identified from source and the retained logs of both sides: which stage of re-establishment fails or stalls, and why.

A behaviour test that fails before the fix reproduces that stall after a satellite-initiated teardown, and after the fix the pair re-establishes without a restart. Any stage that cannot complete reports a named reason. No wall-clock thresholds.
The review pair is clean, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
